pull_request.title: Tracker: Select phi-tilted short-strip barrel baseline
pull_request.head: codex/short-strip-tilted-baseline
pull_request.body:
Select the **+15° phi-tilted short-strip barrel as the working baseline**, as requested. Model, compact-export and coverage commands without `--input` now select the retained tilted input; the default standalone CMake compact/audit follows it. The tangential input, historical drawings and retained failures remain explicit comparison controls.

**Stacked on #49**, which supplies the detailed barrel implementation. Review/merge that parent first, then retarget this follow-up to main. This PR selects the detailed barrel default; DES-020 remains DRAFT and the documented barrel/endcap and engineering constraints remain review gates.

The selected layout has44/56/80/108 staves and28 rows: **288 staves /8,064 modules**. Radii260/340/480/660mm, active±1200mm, anisotropic cells, surviving transforms, local components and fixed services match the already tested alternative. The complete stave rotates together. `inputs.json` remains the historical7,952-module control; CMake exports it as `compact-control/` and audits it independently.

![Tangential control and selected tilted baseline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/75c8df68fac13b0db9dd4812c9404b1a24011437/docs/design/figures/DES-020-phi-tilted-comparison.png)

The **right-hand layout is selected**. The retained drawing's “alternative” label records the earlier comparison, preserving its historical provenance.

| Identical refined sample | Tangential missed crossings | Selected tilted missed crossings |
|---|---:|---:|
| Straight |1311 (0.713%)|225 (0.122%)|
| Positive,1GeV/4T |1132 (0.620%)|210 (0.115%)|
| Negative,1GeV/4T |1135 (0.622%)|174 (0.095%)|

These are eligible layer-crossing losses, not track efficiency. Both have zero sampled misses beyond100mm from nominal ends, but end losses remain. Tilt and module count change together; no tilt-only performance or continuum coverage claim.

Validation: fresh configure/build and **3/3 CTests passed**, including11 Python controls and native audits of both default and control. Zero native overlaps at unchanged1e−5mm, complete transforms/IDs/materials and navigation checks. Default CLI output and full retained tilted snapshot match;38 historical input/artifact/drawing files are byte-identical. Logger116 task/120 primary records and dashboard48 tasks/26 documents/19 reviews validated/built. Full parent/main-relative whitespace checks pass. Retained Geant4/ROOT-persistence/coverage are prior actual runs; this selection did not rerun them or change their execution hashes.

Token accounting: recovered the two completed implementation turns and the read-only coverage comparison exactly once in their canonical owners: **17,083,231**, **11,008,446**, and **271,319** total tokens respectively (**28,362,996 combined**). Five counters, persisted boundaries, request counts, verified event hashes and original recovery source are retained in `logs/usage/USAGE-2026-10-06-short-strip-barrel-turns.json`. Cached/reasoning counters are subsets. Model/client version and older project coverage remain unknown/partial. A bounded recovery after this promotion turn closes will append its final counters separately; no active partial total was imported.

Collector51.54% fill>50%, collector/endcap conflict, adverse services/thermal/data, seat/web/joint strength, electronics/CTE, hydraulics and full-detector integration remain open or failed as documented. Working baseline selection does not grant engineering sign-off.

Refs #20; DES-020/DES-007/DES-011. See `docs/validation/DES-020/baseline-selection.md` and the updated reproduction guide.

comments.body: Tilt has better coverage - new default is decided.
